'''Veedrig''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] male under the employ of [[Toborro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Commissioned to build ''[[The Ark]]'', Veedrig, assisted by [[Batza]], used the project as a means for profit, cutting corners and endangering his workers. Guarded by Hutt droids, workers like the project's foreman [[Tiero]] were not able to protest the conditions they were operating in. The arrival of a Republic strike force ended his leadership of the project, to be replaced by Tiero.

==Behind the scenes==
Veedrig is a NPC in the 2011 [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]] MMO video game.

Veedrig's fate is decided two ways after the player(s) defeat him:
*Spare his life in exchange for his help with the ark (Light side dialogue)
*Execute him (dark side dialogue)
